supportingSources.label: Portal Extended full tutorial and gameplay

strategy.overview: In Portal Extended, work in the Hub to prepare Turret, Faith Plate, and Edgeless Safety Cube Multiballs. Start Turret first if you want a three-Multiball stack, then add the other two before returning to the Test Chambers.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit the Elevator Call Button and then the raised far-left scoop to start a Test Chamber. For a big Hub stack, start Turret Multiball first, then add Faith Plate and Edgeless Safety Cube.
strategy.summary: In the Hub, prepare Test Chambers and three stackable Multiballs. Hit the Elevator Call Button and Elevator Scoop for a chamber. For the full Multiball stack, collect three Turret locks and start Turret first, then add Aerial Faith Plate and Edgeless Safety Cube.
checkBeforePlay: This shot map is for Portal Extended. Portal Standard omits the lower extension and substitutes some required shots in software.
Confirm that the game is on Portal 1.2.3.0 with module driver 1.0.3.4 or newer before relying on current jackpot and option behavior.

quickInfo.name: Start a Test Chamber
quickInfo.summary: Hit the Elevator Call Button, then shoot the raised far-left Elevator Scoop.

quickInfo.name: Turret Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the Turret Lock standup, collect the red Turret Control Center scoop, and repeat for three locks.

quickInfo.name: Aerial Faith Plate Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Enter the L.O.F.T., push the Companion Cube back, then hit three lit Faith Plate shots.

quickInfo.name: Edgeless Safety Cube Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the ESC captive ball twice, then hit the Ramp Control Target while the virtual ball crosses the display.

steps.text: In the Hub, hit the Elevator Call Button standup and shoot the raised far-left Elevator Scoop when you want to enter the selected Test Chamber.
Before leaving the Hub for a large stack, hit the Turret Lock standup and collect the red Turret Control Center scoop three times. Start Turret Multiball first.
Prepare Faith Plate by raising the left ramp, shooting under it into the L.O.F.T., and using the right white flipper button to push the Companion Cube back through its portal.
Hit three lit Faith Plate shots to start Aerial Faith Plate Multiball. It can be added after Turret has started.
Hit the ESC captive ball twice, then hit the Ramp Control Target while the virtual ball travels across the screen to start Edgeless Safety Cube Multiball.
Once the Hub stack is spent, return to Test Chambers. Main Multiballs cannot progress in a chamber, and a chamber cannot start during a main Multiball.
Start Test Chambers 1 through 6. Completion helps, but starting each one is enough for final qualification.
Unlock and start Test Chamber 7, Turret Manufacturing.
After all seven chambers have been played, the final wizard mode begins automatically.

cautions.issue: Portal Standard and Extended share software but not the same physical shot map.
cautions.response: Use these exact locations on Extended. On Standard, follow the lit substitute shots chosen by the hardware-aware software.

cautions.issue: Portal 1.2.3.0 changed Multiball, jackpot, item, and bonus behavior after the November 2025 tutorial.
cautions.response: Use the current starts and stacking behavior; read the display for current values.
